result.summary: The street features a wide roadway with integrated trolley tracks and narrow sidewalks on both sides. There is a lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures, and utility poles obstruct the already narrow walkways.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway create a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a skidding hazard for cyclists.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk, reducing the clear path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen sidewalks or relocate utility poles to ensure a continuous, unobstructed clear path.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with row houses and a continuous sidewalk. While the walkway is present and separated by a curb, there is no buffer from the roadway and the environment lacks street trees or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no planting strip or parked cars to provide physical or psychological separation.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Debris and Litter
hazards.description: Scattered trash and debris on the roadway and sidewalk surface can create slip/trip hazards.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees and a planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a buffer from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: If this were at an intersection, curb extensions would shorten crossing distances and improve visibility, though mid-block they can be used to create space for trees.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though the pavement condition is visibly degraded and uneven.
